scripts.setup: npm ci --prefix server && npm ci --prefix client
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.demo: concurrently -k -n api,web "npm run demo --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm test && npm run build
scripts.format: prettier --write client/src client/*.ts client/*.js server AppScanner/App.js AppScanner/app.json *.json ReadMe.md .github
